items.title: Full-Stack Web Development

From state management and accessibility to server-side rendering and database integration, every layer is built for longevity.

whyNeeded.description: Optimized Core Web Vitals keep visitors engaged, reduce bounce rates, and improve search visibility.

SEO and metadata optimization with JSON-LD schemas

CI/CD pipeline and automated cloud deployment

faqs.question: What is the typical timeline for a web project?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by scope. A focused product MVP typically takes 3 to 6 weeks from kickoff to deployment.

faqs.question: How do you ensure accessibility compliance?
faqs.answer: Every interactive control is keyboard-accessible, passes WCAG AA contrast ratios, and supports assistive screen readers.

items.title: API & Backend Engineering
items.tagline: Resilient, high-throughput backend services and microservices.
items.summary: Dependable RESTful APIs and microservices engineered with Java, Spring Boot, and relational databases.
definition: Backend engineering provides the secure foundation, data storage, and business logic that powers modern applications.
Engineered with strict validation, connection pooling, and transactional boundaries to ensure flawless uptime.

whyNeeded.title: Scalable Throughput
whyNeeded.description: Handle thousands of concurrent requests with efficient connection pooling and asynchronous processing.

whyNeeded.title: Data Integrity
whyNeeded.description: Strict transactional guarantees and schema validation prevent corruption and data loss.

deliverables: RESTful API design and OpenAPI documentation
Relational database schema modeling and indexing
Automated unit and integration test suites

process.description: Robust Spring Boot services with connection pooling and caching.

faqs.question: Do you handle database migrations?
faqs.answer: Yes, all schema evolutions are scripted with versioned migration tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

faqs.question: How do you secure API endpoints?
faqs.answer: Using industry standards including JWT authentication, role-based access control, rate limiting, and encrypted payloads.

whyNeeded.title: Zero-Downtime Releases

whyNeeded.title: Predictable Costs

Automated GitHub Actions workflows for lint, test, and build

faqs.question: Which cloud provider do you recommend?
faqs.answer: AWS is typically best for complex enterprise architectures, while platforms like Vercel or Railway excel for rapid product launches.

faqs.question: Can you containerize legacy applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, I containerize existing Spring Boot, Node.js, and multi-service systems into standard Docker Compose workflows.
